messages:
Alex: Quick heads-up — I tried the minimal Next starter + LlamaIndex sample app we link from docs and hit SDK parity/auth weirdness.
Maya: ugh, what happened? steps?
Alex: Steps:
1) yarn create next-app && add sample
2) npm i @redwood-inference/sdk @llamaindex/core
3) run dev with NEXT_PUBLIC_RW_KEY set to ephemeral token
Command I ran:
```
NEXT_PUBLIC_RW_KEY=ephemeral_... yarn dev
```
Result: app fails when fetching embeddings with 401 sometimes, then later 429s. Looks like token refresh race + retry not wired in the example.
Sam: That sounds like the client isn't auto-refreshing ephemeral keys. Which SDK version?
Alex: Using `@redwood-inference/sdk@0.9.0-canary` (from the starter's package.json). I saw this in console:
```
Error: unauthorized
    at fetchEmbeddings (sdk/dist/index.js:45)
```
Maya: Starter should use stable pinned version; can you repro with a service token instead of NEXT_PUBLIC_? If service token works, it's def ephemeral flow.
Alex: Service token works fine, so ephemeral refresh is the problem. Also noticed the retry policy is completely absent in the starter — a single failure surfaces to the UI.
Sam: Workaround: wrap client calls with a tiny retry helper. Example:
```
async function withRetry(fn, retries=3){
  for(let i=0;i<retries;i++){
    try{return await fn();}catch(e){ if(i===retries-1) throw e; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r, 200*(i+1))); }
  }
}
const res = await withRetry(()=>client.embeddings.create({input:'hi'}));
```
Katie: Good. We should patch the starter: change to server-side token usage for now + add note about ephemeral client flow + add that retry helper into examples.
Alex: Also opened a tiny PR with the note and retry util: https://github.com/redwood-inference/next-llama-starter/pull/23 :wave:
Maya: Can we also make the JS SDK default safer — e.g., treat NEXT_PUBLIC_* keys as preview-only and enable built-in 2-attempt retry for auth failures? cc @Sam
Sam: Yes, adding a default backoff for 401->reauth makes sense. I'll file an issue in the SDK repo and add an opt-in `authRetry` flag before default.
devex-bot: CI check passed for PR #23 :white_check_mark:
Katie: Follow-up task: update onboarding checklist: "Use server token in starter until ephemeral refresh is stable" and add a short eval harness that hits the embeddings/re-ranking flow to catch this in e2e.
Alex: Thanks — leaving my reproduction steps and logs in the PR. Happy to help test the SDK change.
Maya: Thanks Alex, great repro. We'll coordinate infra/SDK patch and update the starter this week. :+1:
